verdict.rationale: Khoj can be self-hosted and supports many local and online models, including through Ollama and LiteLLM, so model failover is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits. The LiteLLM doc only says Khoj can use any LLM behind an API; it does not mention fallback or retry routing.
